properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.mail.title-prefix
properties.description: Prefix prepended to the email subject (e.g., environment label). Write it in application.yml if it contains non-ASCII characters, since application.properties is read as ISO-8859-1.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.mail.address-csv-on-system-error
properties.description: Comma-separated list of addresses to notify on system error.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.mail.debug
properties.description: Whether to enable JavaMail debug output.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.core.app-conf-dir
properties.description: Directory an app externalizes its config to, set in the app's own bundled application.properties. SplibEnvironmentPostProcessor looks for logback-spring.xml here; the app also references it from spring.config.import.
